name: EPIC 210380524
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 9.2 solar radii and 1.18 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210380524 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 9.186342 (16th-84th percentiles 8.800021-9.583673), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210380524 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1506.289062 (16th-84th percentiles 1458.320312-1556.269531), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

text.card: A red giant 1,506 parsecs away, 9 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 1.18 solar masses and 9.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,793 K at its surface.
